claim: On February 21, 2023 the documentation history added that you can reduce the history retention period of completed workflow executions from 90 days to 30 days.
question: Since when can you reduce the Step Functions execution history retention from 90 days to 30 days?

qualifiers.scope: execution history retention of completed workflow executions

note: d002. Current-truth fact: step-functions-execution-history-retention (90 days default, reducible to 30 days by quota request). The default of 90 days did not change; the 30-day option is new.
